item.title: The Largest Crypto Heist in History Could Have Been Avoided
item.description: North Korea pulled off the largest heist in history, stealing $6 billion from crypto exchange Binance. What will it take for policymakers to wake up to these threats?

item.title: The 2027 Congress and the Dangerous Data Breach Pileup
item.description: The next Congress has an opportunity for bipartisan oversight, legislation, and support to public servants by ensuring mitigations of the multiple, serious data breaches that have recently impacted the executive branch.

item.title: European Nations State Their Vision for the Future of European Security
item.description: A group of 40 European states making up the vast majority of the continent just adopted the “Declaration on key principles of European security.” Europeans are proactively putting on the record their vision of security, pushing back on Russia.

item.title: Foreign Policy in the American Heartland: Issues for the 120th Congress
item.description: A new CSIS survey on U.S. foreign policy with registered voters across seven battleground states provides fresh insights into the preferences of a group that could determine the future direction of American foreign policy more than any other group of voters.

item.title: Assessing Nigeria's Efforts to protect Christians and Secure the Middle Belt
item.description: Counterterrorism successes do not, by themselves, establish that vulnerable communities are consistently safer. There is not yet sufficient evidence that the underlying problems of prevention, state capacity, accountability, and impunity have been adequately addressed.

item.title: William Daley and Paul Ryan Named Chair and Vice Chair of the CSIS Board of Trustees
item.description: The Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS) today announced the appointment of William Daley, former White House chief of staff and U.S. secretary of commerce, as chair of its board of trustees. Paul Ryan, former speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives, has been appointed vice chair.

item.description: This edition of States Weekly covers November 11, 2026.
